language_check.method: Script screen only; Latin-script languages are not automatically distinguished from English.

windows.quote:
Hi Morgan,

Thank you for your patience while I checked order R-214. I confirmed that the second payment was taken on 18 September. I understand why seeing two charges would be frustrating, and I'm sorry for the extra work this has caused you.

This morning I requested a refund of the duplicate £36 payment. The payment team hasn't approved it yet. The request covers only that duplicate payment; I can't cancel the first payment because the order has already shipped.

If the team approves the request, the money should reach the original card within five working days. That's an estimate, not a guaranteed arrival date. You don't need to submit another form while the request is pending.

I'll email you by 3 p.m. on Friday even if I'm still waiting for a decision. If you don't receive that update, please reply to this email with the order number.

Best,
Alex

known_limitations: In the saved 36-document English pilot, high-score false positives occurred on human writing. Do not treat a near-1 score as established authorship.
notes: Four-class model outputs are not proof of authorship or percentages of words.
AI involvement = ai + ai_edited + humanized; human is the mutually exclusive class.
Multi-window document aggregation has not been calibrated; document probability is unavailable.
The model card's threshold at 0.5% FPR is a vendor benchmark setting, not a local guarantee.
Short passages, translations and unfamiliar domains can be unreliable.

occlusion.interpretation: Sensitivity to deleting a paragraph. Positive delta means removal lowered the score; length/context changes confound this. This is not causal authorship evidence or a sentence probability.
